US.fact: District court (Epic v. Apple): Apple violated the anti-steering injunction; apps may link to web checkout, 0% commission
Ninth Circuit (No. 25-2935) affirmed contempt but reversed the outright ban on commissions; Apple may charge only for genuinely and reasonably necessary costs once a rate is approved
Supreme Court granted Apple's petition limited to Question 1 (No. 25-1311); stay denied by Justice Kagan 13.08.2026; argument set for 11.01.2027
Apple proposed link-out commissions: 15% standard, 10% partner programs and subscription renewals, 5% Small Business Program; not approved yet
Match Group: link-out purchases 'still 0% commissions'; ~$130M savings expected in 2026

EU.fact: From 01.10.2026: IAP 26% (15% Small Business / programs / renewals after year 1); alternative in-app processing 20% (10%); link-out 15% (10%); 5% Core Technology Commission outside App Store. Under 13: no link-outs; under 18: parental gate

benchmarks.fact: Web = 3.2% of subscription-app revenue globally, 4.9% in North America, 0.8% IN/SEA; 41% of top-tier apps have web revenue vs 1.3% of hobby apps
Dipsea A/B test: trial start 27.0% IAP vs 18.1% web; web net revenue -6.4% at 30% Apple fee; at 15% fee web yields ~$0.77 per $1 of IAP
3 apps, 1 year: web conversion -26%, ARPU +53% at 30% fee; ARPU -9% at 15% fee
